title: wg: content-09 §4.5 contentHash input unclear
description: Suggestion. L752 "hash of the content at the target url", but §4.5 says private content is AEAD-encrypted before upload; the hash could cover plaintext or ciphertext. mimid hashes the ciphertext, which also works when encAlg=0 (decision mimid-1wgh.2.12). Fix: say which.
notes: Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: 'content at the target url' already means ciphertext; one-sentence clarification.
